Checking all orbital parameters in the Moon infobox and calculating the exact hours.
```python
cmd = '''python -c "
import urllib.request
import json

url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page=Moon&prop=wikitext&format=json'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
res = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
data = json.loads(res.read().decode('utf-8'))
wt = data['parse']['wikitext']['*']

lines = wt.splitlines()
for i, line in enumerate(lines[:100]):
    if '|' in line or 'perigee' in line.lower() or 'orbit' in line.lower():
        print(f'{i}: {line}')
"'''
res_infobox_lines = await run_command(cmd)
print(res_infobox_lines)
```
